integrity: The proof uses three verified ingredients from the full primary text: the cap-radius-independent single-ball weak-type theorem, the exact cap Hausdorff–Choquet norm power, and the fixed indicator lower test from the sharpness proof. Their quotient yields the stated two-sided rate without numerical evidence.
scientific_limitations: The result is a two-sided quantitative law for normalized geodesic-cap kernels. It does not classify arbitrary supercritical Hausdorff–Choquet kernels, optimize constants, or settle the full L1 angular-kernel endpoint problem.
title: Exact aperture blow-up above the Hausdorff–Choquet rough-maximal threshold
